items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I like that, that style. ... I don't think you have a record of Emmett Hardy. ... You know? Well, I might be wrong. I'm a, maybe, maybe it's something I'd overheard that their styles were...

ctx.x: I like to play their stuff, you know. Any other trumpet players you can think of from your records?
Uh, I like, uh, I like Johnny Wigg. I like the way Johnny Wigg plays. He has a simple pure style. I like that. Uh, he, uh, let's see, I'm trying to think of this, this other, was it Emmett Hardy?
